about: Tags for Franklin & Marshall College that OpenStreetMap does not have yet. Every campus building is red brick (Old Main and Steinman College Center checked on photos; the campus is described as brick architecture), sloped roofs are grey slate (as seen from above), Steinman's flat roof is white, and the Winter Visual Arts Center (2020, after the 2019 laser scan) gets its published form instead of the scan. Heights and roof shapes come from the laser scan (--lidar), not from here. Use: python place2mc.py --osm-file place2mc-data.json --lidar place2mc-data.json --center 40.04966,-76.31705 --radius 768 --tags examples/fandm/fandm-tags.json
